copy.tagline: Flip the cards, remember the pairs, beat the clock.
copy.description: Sixteen cards, eight pairs. The fewer moves and the faster you finish, the higher your score. Ideal for a short break, tough when you chase a record.
controls: Click or tap a card, then find its pair.
A wrong pair flips back and costs 25 points.
Every second counts against your score, so be quick.
